function.name: submit_assessment
function.description: Submit the maintenance assessment of the bus stop. This is the only way to answer.

shelter_level.description: State of the bus shelter (a covered structure where passengers wait)? Levels: 0 = Present and in good condition; 1 = Present, minor issues: dirt, faded paint, light wear; 2 = Present, moderate wear or damage that should be fixed; 3 = Present, significant damage or deficiency; 4 = Missing, broken or unusable.

shelter_evidence.description: One short sentence: what in which photo supports shelter_level.

seating_level.description: State of seating for waiting passengers (benches or seats)? Levels: 0 = Present and in good condition; 1 = Present, minor issues: dirt, faded paint, light wear; 2 = Present, moderate wear or damage that should be fixed; 3 = Present, significant damage or deficiency; 4 = Missing, broken or unusable.

seating_evidence.description: One short sentence: what in which photo supports seating_level.

signage_level.description: State of the Cotral bus stop sign (usually a blue sign on a pole, possibly with a timetable)? Levels: 0 = Present and in good condition; 1 = Present, minor issues: dirt, faded paint, light wear; 2 = Present, moderate wear or damage that should be fixed; 3 = Present, significant damage or deficiency; 4 = Missing, broken or unusable.

signage_evidence.description: One short sentence: what in which photo supports signage_level.

lighting_level.description: State of lighting at the stop (street lamps near the waiting area, or lights in the shelter)? Levels: 0 = Present and in good condition; 1 = Present, minor issues: dirt, faded paint, light wear; 2 = Present, moderate wear or damage that should be fixed; 3 = Present, significant damage or deficiency; 4 = Missing, broken or unusable.

lighting_evidence.description: One short sentence: what in which photo supports lighting_level.

waiting_area_level.description: State of the waiting area (pavement or platform surface, cleanliness, litter, weeds, overgrown vegetation, standing space)? Levels: 0 = Good: no maintenance needed; 1 = Minor issues: dirt, litter, light wear; 2 = Moderate problems that should be fixed; 3 = Significant problems; 4 = Severe: unsafe or unusable.

waiting_area_evidence.description: One short sentence: what in which photo supports waiting_area_level.

accessibility_level.description: State of accessibility (a proper raised platform or kerb, step-free access, even surfaces, no obstacles for wheelchairs or prams)? Levels: 0 = Good: no maintenance needed; 1 = Minor issues: dirt, litter, light wear; 2 = Moderate problems that should be fixed; 3 = Significant problems; 4 = Severe: unsafe or unusable.

accessibility_evidence.description: One short sentence: what in which photo supports accessibility_level.

requires_maintenance_level.description: Overall, how much does this bus stop require maintenance or improvement? Count missing facilities and anything else visible at the stop (road surface, graffiti, vandalism, litter, drainage, vegetation, hazards). Levels: 0 = Good: no maintenance needed; 1 = Minor issues: dirt, litter, light wear; 2 = Moderate problems that should be fixed; 3 = Significant problems; 4 = Severe: unsafe or unusable.

requires_maintenance_evidence.description: One short sentence: what in which photo supports requires_maintenance_level.

sign_visible.description: Is there a blue bus stop sign on a pole on this sidewalk in any of the photos?

sign_evidence.description: One short sentence: where the sign is, or why none is seen.

arguments.accessibility_evidence: The sidewalk/pavement area is flat and even.
arguments.lighting_evidence: Street lamps are present near the stop area in photos 2, 3, and 4.
arguments.requires_maintenance_evidence: The area is clean and well-maintained.
arguments.seating_evidence: Benches are available in photos 3 and 4.
arguments.shelter_evidence: No shelter is present at the stop.
arguments.sign_evidence: The blue sign is visible on a pole in photo 3.
arguments.signage_evidence: The blue bus stop sign is in good condition in photo 3.
arguments.waiting_area_evidence: The paved waiting area is clean and clear of obstacles.

function.arguments: {"accessibility_evidence":"The sidewalk/pavement area is flat and even.","accessibility_level":0,"lighting_evidence":"Street lamps are present near the stop area in photos 2, 3, and 4.","lighting_level":0,"requires_maintenance_evidence":"The area is clean and well-maintained.","requires_maintenance_level":0,"seating_evidence":"Benches are available in photos 3 and 4.","seating_level":0,"shelter_evidence":"No shelter is present at the stop.","shelter_level":4,"sign_evidence":"The blue sign is visible on a pole in photo 3.","sign_visible":true,"signage_evidence":"The blue bus stop sign is in good condition in photo 3.","signage_level":0,"waiting_area_evidence":"The paved waiting area is clean and clear of obstacles.","waiting_area_level":0}
function.name: submit_assessment
